A script to compile the occurrence cubes from different ranks into a single cube.

```{r libraries}
library(readr)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r set ranks}
ranks <- c("GENUS", "FAMILY", "SPECIES", "SUBSPECIES_FORM_VARIETY")
```

```{r read in the data, message=NA}
# get a list of all the files in the cube_data folder
cube_files <- list.files(path = "./cube_data/", 
                         pattern = "be_alientaxa_cube_.+\\.csv$", 
                         recursive = TRUE, 
                         full.names = TRUE)

# Create an empty data frame to store the compiled cube
compiled_cube <- data.frame()

# Define the path to the folder containing the occurrence cubes
for(r in cube_files){
  # Read in the cube
  cube <- read_csv(r)
  
  # add rank info
  cube$rank <- str_extract(r, "be_alientaxa_cube_(.+?)\\.csv$") %>% 
    str_replace_all("be_alientaxa_cube_", "") %>% 
    str_replace_all(".csv", "") %>%
    toupper()
  
  # Combine the cube with the compiled cube
  compiled_cube <- compiled_cube %>% bind_rows(cube)
}
```

```{r map compiled cube to match occ cube format, message=NA}
compiled_cube <- compiled_cube %>% 
  filter(!is.na(eeacellcode)) %>%
  mutate(taxonKey = case_when(
    rank == "SPECIES" ~ specieskey,
    rank == "GENUS" ~ genuskey,
    rank == "FAMILY" ~ familykey,
    rank == "SUBSPECIES_FORM_VARIETY" ~ taxonkey,
    rank == "NO_FILTER" ~ taxonkey,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)
  )) 

missing_taxonKeys <- compiled_cube %>% 
  filter(is.na(taxonKey)) %>% 
  distinct(rank) 

if(nrow(missing_taxonKeys) > 0){
  stop(paste0("Missing taxonKeys for ranks: ", paste(missing_taxonKeys$rank, collapse = ", ")))
}

cat("These ranks where included in the compiled cube: ", compiled_cube %>% select(rank) %>% distinct() %>% pull())

compiled_cube <- compiled_cube %>% 
  select(year, 
         "eea_cell_code" = "eeacellcode", 
         taxonKey, 
         classKey,
         obs = "occurrences", 
         min_coord_uncertainty = "mincoordinateuncertaintyinmeters")
```

```{r write compiled cube}
# Write the compiled cube to a csv file
write_csv(compiled_cube, "./cube_data/be_alientaxa_cube.csv")
```
